# alva moor

> Visual artist. Abstract paintings — atmospheric, layered, and intuitive.
> Studio in Leipzig and Berlin.

alva moor works in acrylics and natural pigments, on canvas and on paper. The
work explores emotional states and attempts to make tensions and atmosphere
visible: painting over, blurring, and deliberately leaving forms open, creating
visual spaces that viewers interpret through their own associations and
memories. At the heart of the current series is freedom in relationships,
translated into fragile pictorial structures, with a constant shift between
control and dissolution.

The site is bilingual. Every page exists under both `/en` and `/de`.

## Works

Two bodies of work, each with its own index page:

- [Works on canvas (EN)](https://alvamoor.com/en/works/canvas) — 14 paintings,
  2026. Acrylic on canvas, 120–250 cm wide by 119–220 cm high.
- [Works on paper (EN)](https://alvamoor.com/en/works/paper) — 31 works,
  2021–2026. Acrylics on paper.
- [Werke auf Leinwand (DE)](https://alvamoor.com/de/works/canvas)
- [Werke auf Papier (DE)](https://alvamoor.com/de/works/paper)
- [All works (EN)](https://alvamoor.com/en/works) · [Alle Werke (DE)](https://alvamoor.com/de/works)

Individual works live at `/{locale}/works/{medium}/{n}`, where `n` is a
zero-based position in that medium's current list. Positions shift as works are
added, so cite the index pages above rather than a numbered work.

## Usage

Text and images on this site are © alva moor, all rights reserved.

This file exists so that assistants can describe and cite the work accurately
from a single request, instead of crawling the site. Reproduction of the
images — including use as training data — is not permitted. Automated crawling
of pages beyond this file is disallowed; see
[/robots.txt](https://alvamoor.com/robots.txt).
